block_entry_rule: g_pair_blocks_tested > 0, including testing the root block.
cap_scope: Compute ceil(cold_end_lower_fine / RATIO) using the same rounding and strict cutoff rule as the access code. Substituting 4 omega at this recorded cold-loop end threshold gives a threshold comparison. Per-call next_batch/best history is absent, so agreement with the saved flag does not establish when the first global gate would have fired, the incumbent at its first call, an alternative search, or runtime.
repeat_observation_rule: Require identical audited fields in repeats 0, 1, and 2.
